name: AcWebBrowserState
description: Used by the ReadyState property to determine the state of the web browser control.

constants.name: acLoading
constants.description: The web browser control is loading a new document.

constants.name: acLoaded
constants.description: The web browser control has loaded and initialized the new document, but has not yet received all the document data.

constants.name: acInteractive
constants.description: The web browser control has loaded enough of the document to allow limited user interaction, such as choosing hyperlinks that have been displayed.

constants.name: acComplete
constants.description: The web browser control has finished loading the new document and all its contents.
